parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

😎
avail[aveil]n.
Avail is help. It is often used in the achievement of a goal.
Avail (Danh từ): Sự giúp ích, lợi ích (thường dùng trong cụm "to no avail" - vô ích).
→ His studying was to no avail because he failed the test.
😎
expand[ikspænd]v.
To expand is to become bigger in size.
Expand (Động từ): Mở rộng, làm cho lớn hơn.
→ A balloon will expand as you blow air into it.
😎
define[difain]v.
To define means to clearly state, show, or explain what something is.
Define (Động từ): Định nghĩa, xác định rõ.
→ People define success in many different ways.
😎
dread[dred]v.
To dread is to be afraid of something that could, or is going to, happen.
Dread (Động từ): Khiếp sợ, kinh sợ.
→ I dread the idea that I will not get into college.
😎
fundamental[fʌndəmentl]adj.
If something is fundamental, it is a basic part of something.
Fundamental (Tính từ): Cơ bản, chủ yếu.
→ The fundamental rules of basketball are easy.
😎
horrifying[hɔ:rəfaiin]adj.
If something is horrifying, it is frightening and very unpleasant.
Horrifying (Tính từ): Kinh hoàng, kinh khủng.
→ There was a horrifying car accident today.
😎
incredulous[inkredʒələs]adj.
If someone is incredulous about something, they do not believe that it is true.
Incredulous (Tính từ): Hoài nghi, không tin.
→ She was incredulous that monkeys could ever drive a car.
😎
linger[liŋgər]v.
To linger is to last for a long time.
Linger (Động từ): Nán lại, kéo dài.
→ The smell of fresh cookies lingered in the bakery.
😎
organism[ɔ:rgənizəm]n.
An organism is a living thing, especially a very small one.
Organism (Danh từ): Sinh vật, thực thể sống.
→ We studied the organism on the microscope.
😎
paraphrase[pærəfreiz]v.
To paraphrase is to make someone else’s writing or speech shorter.
Paraphrase (Động từ): Diễn giải lại, viết lại bằng từ khác.
→ The students were asked to paraphrase the story they just heard.
😎
plague[pleig]n.
A plague is a serious disease that quickly spreads to many people.
Plague (Danh từ): Bệnh dịch.
→ A plague in Europe killed millions of people.
😎
presently[prezəntli]adv.
If something happens presently, it is happening right now.
Presently (Trạng từ): Hiện tại, ngay lúc này.
→ Presently, our profits are good, but by next year we can do even better.
😎
random[rændəm]adj.
If something is random, it happens without any pattern or reason.
Random (Tính từ): Ngẫu nhiên, tình cờ.
→ Young children often ask random questions.
😎
riot[raiət]n.
A riot is a crowd that reacts to bad news by violently breaking laws.
Riot (Danh từ): Cuộc bạo loạn.
→ A riot broke out after the candidate lost the election.
😎
scribble[skribl]v.
To scribble is to write something quickly without caring about how it looks.
Scribble (Động từ): Viết ngoáy, viết vội.
→ I scribbled a rough diagram of our plan and gave it to him.
😎
shrine[ʃrain]n.
A shrine is a religious building built to honor a person, event, or god.
Shrine (Danh từ): Ngôi đền, điện thờ.
→ He prayed at the shrine for an hour.
😎
solitude[salitju:d]n.
Solitude is the state of being totally alone.
Solitude (Danh từ): Sự cô đơn, trạng thái một mình.
→ John lives a life of solitude because he doesn’t get along well with people.
😎
stark[sta:rk]adj.
If a contrast is stark, then the things being compared are utterly different.
Stark (Tính từ): Rõ rệt, hoàn toàn.
→ There is a stark contrast between their test scores.
😎
summon[sʌmən]v.
To summon a person is to ask them to come to you.
Summon (Động từ): Triệu tập, gọi đến.
→ We summoned the doctor as soon as we noticed she was sick.
😎
worsen[wə:rsən]v.
To worsen is to get worse.
Worsen (Động từ): Trở nên tồi tệ hơn.
→ The weather suddenly worsened, and we had to stay inside.

sections.title: Exercise 1, Part A
sections.content: Choose the right word for the given definition.

questions.explanation: summon có nghĩa là triệu tập, yêu cầu ai đó đến (to ask someone to come).
fundamental có nghĩa là cơ bản (basic).
expand có nghĩa là mở rộng, trở nên lớn hơn (to get bigger).
dread có nghĩa là khiếp sợ, e sợ (to be afraid).
incredulous có nghĩa là hoài nghi, không tin (not believing).

sections.title: Exercise 1, Part B
sections.content: Choose the right definition for the given word.

questions.explanation: plague có nghĩa là bệnh dịch (a disease).
solitude có nghĩa là sự cô đơn, trạng thái ở một mình (being alone).
define có nghĩa là định nghĩa, giải thích rõ ràng (to explain clearly).
organism có nghĩa là sinh vật, thực thể sống (a living thing).
horrifying có nghĩa là kinh khủng, rất khó chịu (very unpleasant).

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
Thucydides and the Plague of Athens

Thucydides was the world’s first historian. Presently, we get most of our knowledge about ancient Greece from his writing. But Thucydides didn’t just write about history, he lived through it. However, he almost didn’t survive one historical event: the Plague of Athens.

In 430 BCE, an army attacked the city of Athens, where Thucydides lived. Thousands of people hid from the army behind Athens’ large walls. The city became very crowded as the population expanded. Then a horrifying disease broke out. People summoned doctors. But it was to no avail because no one understood how the disease spread.

It seemed random. They didn’t know that it was an organism. Instead, they defined disease as a punishment from their gods. Thucydides was incredulous that gods caused the plague, but he explained why others believed it. There was an old, long verse which predicted the disease. To paraphrase it, the verse said the gods would send a disease during a war. As a result, large crowds gathered at shrines to ask the gods to stop the plague. But the situation only worsened because these people were so close to each other they became sick. That’s how they learned a fundamental lesson about the plague: it spread from person to person.

People wanted to leave the crowded city, but they dreaded what the army outside would do to them. At this time, Thucydides got sick, too. He quickly scribbled down notes because he thought he would soon die. His writing shows a stark contrast between people’s behavior before and during the plague. There were riots, and people ignored laws. They didn’t think they’d live long enough to be punished. Many sick people were left to die in solitude because no one wanted to be near them. The plague lingered for two years. But luckily, Thucydides survived. Without his writing, we would know much less about ancient Greece and the Plague of Athens.

sections.title: Reading Comprehension, Part A
sections.content: Mark each statement True or False.

questions.content: Presently, a horrifying plague has broken out in Athens.
questions.explanation: Câu này sai. Dịch bệnh xảy ra từ thời xưa. "In 430 BCE, an army attacked the city of Athens... Then a horrifying disease broke out."

questions.content: At first, people thought the spread of the disease was random.
questions.explanation: Câu này đúng. Bài đọc có ghi "It seemed random." (Trông nó có vẻ như ngẫu nhiên).

questions.content: The people summoned doctors to no avail.
questions.explanation: Câu này đúng. "People summoned doctors. But it was to no avail because no one understood how the disease spread." (Họ đã gọi bác sĩ nhưng vô ích).

questions.content: Thucydides was incredulous that the plague was caused by an organism.
questions.explanation: Câu này sai. Ông không tin căn bệnh do chư thần gây ra. "Thucydides was incredulous that gods caused the plague" (Thucydides không tin rằng chư thần đã gây ra bệnh dịch).

questions.content: By gathering in shrines, people made the plague worse.
questions.explanation: Câu này đúng. "But the situation only worsened because these people were so close to each other they became sick." (Nhưng tình hình trở nên tồi tệ hơn vì mọi người đứng quá gần nhau tại các đền thờ).
Câu này đúng. Đoạn cuối bài có ghi: "But luckily, Thucydides survived." (Nhưng may mắn thay, Thucydides đã sống sót).

sections.title: Reading Comprehension, Part B
sections.content: Answer the questions.

options: Because the army moved into the city
Because people were hiding from the army
Because the army told people to enter
questions.explanation: Dẫn chứng: "Thousands of people hid from the army behind Athens’ large walls. The city became very crowded as the population expanded." (Hàng ngàn người trốn tránh quân đội sau những bức tường lớn khiến dân số tăng lên).

options: he had to define the disease
there were too many sick people
questions.explanation: Dẫn chứng: "He quickly scribbled down notes because he thought he would soon die." (Ông vội vàng viết tốc ký vì nghĩ mình sẽ sớm qua đời).

questions.content: What fundamental lesson did the people learn?
options: The plague was ended in the shrines.
The plague was from the army.
The plague was spread between people.
questions.explanation: "That’s how they learned a fundamental lesson about the plague: it spread from person to person." (Họ học được một bài học cơ bản là bệnh lây truyền từ người sang người).

questions.content: What is NOT true of Thucydides?
options: He was the world’s first historian.
He thought gods caused the plague.
He survived the Plague of Athens.
He lived in the city of Athens.
questions.explanation: Ông không hề tin như vậy. "Thucydides was incredulous that gods caused the plague" (Ông hoài nghi việc chư thần gây ra dịch bệnh).
